_meta.description: R1 comment-fidelity baseline census of the READ-ONLY ghostty reference. Every comment line in src/**.zig is counted and classified. This is the contract the port's fidelity critic diffs against; no comment may be dropped.

classes.doc-decl: ///  declaration doc comment (//// is a plain line comment)

_meta.notes: `//` inside string literals, char literals, and multiline string content (\\...) is NOT counted as a comment. A comment may carry multiple tags (todo_fixme, note, spec, ascii_diagram); tags are non-exclusive overlays, not a partition.
